@@U04368@@
I pray the magnitude of this great enterprise will glorify God, but also bring me absolution. I already feel my spirit being lifted.

@@U04370@@
As Chancellor I must now ask one final formality.

@@U04372@@
A formal deed of transfer, yes— to the Church. Bring it and I'll gladly sign. (The CHANCELLOR-ARCHBISHOP has taken his leave but turns back at the door.)

@@U04374@@
You will, besides, assign to this work all of the revenues of said property, tithes, taxes, payments in kind— in perpetuity. Grand sums will be required for proper maintenance, not to mention administrative costs. What’s more, given the desolation of the site, you will give us gold from your war booty. It will help to speed the progress. Ah, yes, and then timber— not to be overlooked— timber, lime, and slate and the like will need transport from distant areas. The workers, of course, will do that. The Church will promise blessings to those who offer use of carts in her service.

@@U04375@@
(Exit.)
translation:
@@U04368@@
我祈祷这一伟大事业的规模能够荣耀上帝，同时也为我带来赦免。我已经感觉到我的精神振奋了。

@@U04370@@
作为财政大臣，我现在必须办理最后一项手续。

@@U04372@@
是的，一份正式的转让契约——转让给教会。把它带来，我很乐意签字。 （大主教已告辞，但在门口又折返。）

@@U04374@@
此外，您还将永久地将上述财产、什一税、税收、实物付款的所有收入分配给这项工作。适当的维护需要巨额资金，更不用说管理费用了。更重要的是，考虑到该地点的荒凉，你将从你的战利品中拿出黄金给我们。这将有助于加快进展。啊，是的，然后木材——不可忽视的——木材、石灰和板岩等都需要从遥远的地区运输。工人们当然会这么做。教会将承诺祝福那些使用手推车为她服务的人。

@@U04375@@
（退出。）
